Name: Setup and recruitment
Project Activity: Complete the cohort to fifteen through the continuing open call and collect signed commitments.

Name: Setup and recruitment
Project Activity: Collect each participant's dataset and a short data description.
Research Question: What types of research data does a mixed ETH cohort hold and which raise the hardest sharing questions?

Name: Setup and recruitment
Project Activity: Run a baseline survey of RDM and RSE experience and competencies.
Research Question: Where do ETH researchers who already carry RDM responsibility stand at the start?

Name: Setup and recruitment
Project Activity: Set up the ETH GitLab and GitHub spaces and the Matrix (Element) channel.

Name: Setup and recruitment
Project Activity: Finalise the workshop schedule and confirm the two Villa Hatt bookings.

Name: Setup and recruitment
Project Activity: Divide the cohort between the two applicants, so each participant has a named contact for their data.

Name: Setup and recruitment
Project Activity: Confirm the Data Stewardship Network link for the programme.

Name: Core workshops and data-package delivery
Project Activity: Git for Scientists. Four hours on Git and GitHub or GitLab collaborative workflows, building on existing material.
Research Question: Can a version-controlled workflow make AI use traceable as a by-product of the work, rather than as an after-the-fact statement?

Name: Core workshops and data-package delivery
Project Activity: FAIR data sharing. Four hours on the openwashdata workflow, using each participant's own data.
Research Question: How does FAIR data sharing practice differ between the disciplines and data types in the cohort?

Name: Core workshops and data-package delivery
Project Activity: GitHub for project and task management. Four hours on GitHub or GitLab for tracking research work.
Research Question: What record of human judgment and decision-making do researchers keep alongside AI-assisted work?

Name: Core workshops and data-package delivery
Project Activity: Agentic AI. Eight hours on agentic AI workflows for data management, at Villa Hatt.
Research Question: How do researchers declare AI use in a way that shows what they still produced themselves?

Name: Core workshops and data-package delivery
Project Activity: Organisational change for open science. Full day at Villa Hatt; the applicants host and participate rather than teach.
Research Question: What organisational change methods work for embedding FAIR practice in an ETH research group?

Name: Core workshops and data-package delivery
Project Activity: FAIR data management. Four hours taking each participant from a documented dataset to a data management strategy for their group.
Research Question: What does a research group need in a data management strategy for FAIR practice to outlast the individual who learned it?

Name: Core workshops and data-package delivery
Project Activity: Run the support hours between workshops and take each dataset through the data-package pipeline to a citable release.

Name: Community building and outreach
Project Activity: Run the day-to-day support channels: Matrix, 1:1 calls, and direct support on each participant's data.

Name: Community building and outreach
Project Activity: Run the quarterly two-hour hands-on project team meetings.

Name: Community building and outreach
Project Activity: Host AI Playground sessions three times per term, open to anyone at ETH and the general public.

Name: Community building and outreach
Project Activity: Publish the programme's material and progress on a public project website, including the OER as produced.

Name: Community building and outreach
Project Activity: Share progress and findings through blog posts and social media, primarily LinkedIn.

Name: Community building and outreach
Project Activity: Present the programme and interim findings at RDM and reproducibility venues and through the DSN and RSE Network.

Name: Community building and outreach
Project Activity: Motivate participants to sign the FAIR Coalition Charter through the programme. Adriana Clavijo Daza signs at the start; Lars Schöbitz and Elizabeth Tilley are already signatories.
Milestone: Cohort signed up to the Charter
Research Question: Does working hands-on with their own data make researchers more willing to commit publicly to FAIR practice?

Name: Consolidation, sustainability, and reporting
Project Activity: Publish the final FAIR data packages with DOIs, citation files with ORCIDs, and Research Collection entries.
Research Question: How do researchers declare AI use on a published data package, and is a binary used-or-not declaration workable in practice?

Name: Consolidation, sustainability, and reporting
Project Activity: Capture the programme as a reusable offering and publish all teaching material as OER with instructor handbooks.
Research Question: Which parts of the programme transfer to another ETH community unchanged, and which have to be rebuilt per discipline?

Name: Consolidation, sustainability, and reporting
Project Activity: Define a light-touch baseline indicator of participants' open data practice and agree how it could be re-measured after the project. Scoped as a design step, not ongoing monitoring within the funded period.
Research Question: Does a hands-on programme change open data and AI-declaration practice durably, beyond the funded year and beyond the cohort?

Name: Consolidation, sustainability, and reporting
Project Activity: Write up the community comparison and AI-declaration recommendations, and submit the final reports.
Research Question: How do FAIR data sharing, data security, and the declaration of AI use differ between the communities in the cohort, and can a light-touch longitudinal indicator track whether participants' open data practice holds after the programme ends?
